title: Existence of the slices ⟨T,f,t₋⟩ (Simon 4.6)
statement: For all P, m, every open U ⊆ ℝ^P, every T ∈ D_{m+1}(U) with M_W(T) < ∞ and M_W(∂T) < ∞ for all open W ⊂⊂ U, every f : ℝ^P → ℝ which is L-Lipschitz on U and every t ∈ ℝ, there is S ∈ D_m(U) with IsSlice T f t S, i.e. S = ∂(T⌞{x ∈ U : f(x) < t}) − (∂T)⌞{x ∈ U : f(x) < t} for some restriction currents in the sense of IsRestriction.
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → ∀ T : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1), (∀ W, CompactlyContainedOpen W U → T.massOn W < ∞ ∧ T.boundary.massOn W < ∞) → ∀ (f : Eucl P → ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0), LipschitzOnWith L f U → ∀ t : ℝ, ∃ S : GeometricCurrentOn U m, IsSlice T f t S
